dedupe_keys.name: numerical modeling of water dynamics in railway embankments

description: Numerical modeling of water dynamics in Railway embankments is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Lucia Pedrosa. This dataset contains input parameters for numerical modeling using HYDRUS to simulate water flow under railway embankments. It was generated to investigate water flow dynamics and distribution in railway embankments, with implications for the transport of herbicides affecting tracks and underlying structures. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
